name: autoposter
description: Publish, schedule, and automate social media posts across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, and Facebook.

interface.longDescription: Auto Poster AI streamlines social media operations by automating multi-platform publishing workflows across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, and Facebook. Connect your accounts to ChatGPT to draft, schedule, and publish posts, check platform formatting rules, and track live published links directly in conversation.
capabilities: Delete or cancel scheduled and draft posts
defaultPrompt: List my connected social media accounts
Draft a post for Facebook and Telegram about our new product update
Schedule an announcement post for tomorrow at 2 PM

positive.prompt: Which social media accounts are connected to my Auto Poster workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns list of active social media accounts with platform names and usernames.

positive.description: Check platform character and format rules
positive.prompt: What are the character limits and rules for posting on Facebook and Telegram?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns character limits, media specs, and guidelines for the requested platforms.

positive.description: Create a post draft for review
positive.prompt: Create a draft post for my Facebook and Telegram accounts saying 'Excited to announce our new AI integration!'
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft post and returns the draft ID and preview.

positive.prompt: Schedule a post for tomorrow at 3 PM on Facebook and Telegram announcing our upcoming webinar.
positive.expected_behavior: Schedules post for the specified datetime and returns scheduled confirmation.

positive.prompt: Show me my scheduled posts and drafts in Auto Poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns list of scheduled posts and drafts with their delivery status.

negative.description: Payment or subscription changes not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Auto Poster subscription or charge my credit card.
Delete my Auto Poster user account and all workspace data permanently.
Show posts and accounts from workspace_random_999 that I do not own.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Removed email from profile tool, expanded privacy disclosure, sanitized error output, and updated category.
